issue.description:
ADR-001 is Accepted but has no corresponding implementation bead. Per the ADR: add a third dependency kind `verifies` so authors can declare a check relationship; diagnose inverted verification gates structurally (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead) and report the diagnosis advisory-only in `bead doctor` — never reject the edge at insert time, and never infer the relationship from issue titles. Closing this requires: a spec section for R025, schema/CLI support for the new edge kind (declare, list, checkpoint round trip), a `ready_frontier`-style doctor diagnostic naming the inverted pairs, field-guide entries for the new kind, and conformance tests proving declared-pair detection has no false positives, undeclared inversions stay silent, and §3.4 cycle rejection still applies.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Specify and implement the `verifies` dependency kind with structural inversion diagnosis (R025)

issue.description:
ADR-001 (docs/adr/001-declared-verification-edges-over-title-heuristics.md) decided to add a third dependency kind `verifies` and to diagnose inverted verification gates structurally from that declaration (advisory only, never from title heuristics, never rejected at insert time). It was explicitly specified as post-0.1 item R025; the project has since shipped 0.2.x and no open bead covers it. Work: extend the dependency model and the section 3.4 edge validation to accept `verifies` edges without weakening cycle rejection; add the inversion detector (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead) as advisory diagnostics surfaced through list/show/doctor; expose the declared relationship to R023's `why` explanation as the ADR notes; add concurrency tests for the new edge kind (every mutating operation must be concurrency-tested) and checkpoint round-trip coverage so the new kind survives export/import and redaction rewrites.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement R025: the declared verifies dependency kind with structural inversion diagnosis
